releaseStatus.title: Release Status
releaseStatus.meta.description: Current release stages for TypeWhisper on macOS, Windows, and iOS.
releaseStatus.subtitle: TypeWhisper ships stable desktop releases for macOS and Windows. iOS remains an early preview.
releaseStatus.mac.detail: This is the official stable path for daily use, documentation, support, and launch messaging.
releaseStatus.win.intro: Windows is a stable desktop release.
releaseStatus.win.detail: Core workflows are ready for daily use on Windows 10 and 11, with local models, file transcription, workflows, integrations, and automatic updates.
releaseStatus.ios.intro: iOS is currently an alpha preview.
releaseStatus.ios.detail: The mobile experience is still experimental and should be treated as early access rather than a broad release.
releaseStatus.mac.title: macOS 1.5
releaseStatus.mac.description: Stable 1.5 direct-download release with app-aware insertion, workflow output controls, automatic correction learning, stronger local model memory handling, more resilient cloud ASR uploads, and fullscreen indicator fixes.
releaseStatus.win.title: Windows
releaseStatus.win.description: Stable Windows desktop release with system-wide dictation, file transcription, workflows, integrations, and local automation.
releaseStatus.ios.title: iOS Alpha
releaseStatus.ios.description: Experimental TestFlight build for very early mobile testing and feedback.
